_comment: Design presets. Each preset is a full visual system: palette + rules. The renderer reads only these tokens, so a new look is a new entry here, not new code.

blockframe.label: Neo-brutalist poster — thick ink borders, hard shadows, candy accent. High click-through.

midnight.label: Deep near-black with a single luminous accent. Calm, premium, good for long explainers.

cobalt-grid.label: Editorial parchment + cobalt grid. Structured, journalistic, works for data-heavy topics.

biennale-yellow.label: Warm parchment + sun yellow, indigo ink, hairline rules. Friendly, gallery-poster feel.

forest.label: Green / cream editorial with a coral counterpoint. Soft, essayistic.

mono.label: Pure black on white, Swiss grid, zero decoration. Maximum legibility, zero brand noise.
